name: Glyphic Rune
label: Quest
description: Glyphic Rune: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Long ago high elves taught us the secrets of magic along with our human allies. They preached to us about rules and how magic can make ya go mad! But don't believe it. We're not like the elves; we don't have the same weaknesses. Just keep yourself on the right path and you'll find magic is as powerful a tool as it is a weapon.
When you're ready, come find me inside Anvilmar. I'll be waiting for ya!
